findings.summary: assertMat4InvertToRefMatchesInvert proved a pinned variant term for term against the lowered mat4Invert (115 lines) and restated its identity fallback in C++; lowerPinnedFunction handles the whole body, so mat4InvertToRefOrIdentity is lowered from its own declaration and the proof, the identity array and the std::optional fork are gone
orthoViewInto was restated in C++ under eight initializer shapes and four lane counts; it is lowered whole like buildLightViewMatrixInto, and the restatement and its assertions are deleted

the CSM statement count (32/35 as literals) was a weaker one-off of the physics lowerer's statement-kind inventory; the inventory and its kind projection moved onto LoweringContext.assertStatementInventory, which both lowerers now call

pinned-wgsl-build.ts transpiled the pinned script, rewrote its miniray import, digested the output and wrote an artifact directory with a fourth copy of the temp-and-rename discipline, only so require could load it; it now executes in memory through node:vm with a require shim, the transpile cached by the bake cache, and transpileCommonJs reused with the esModuleInterop flag it needed

browser-generated-string.ts carried a second predicate for the pin's wgsl tag with its own module-path regex; it takes CompilerSymbols.pinnedWgslTemplate from the compiler and removes the pin's own range, tag start to template start

compileShaderSource unwrapped an arrow builder's expression body ad hoc while compileStringLiteral's factory reader still saw the tag; one builderReturn accessor (expression body or single-return block, unwrapped) serves both
Compiler.unwrap and StaticEvaluator.unwrap were the same loop, both extended with the tag branch; the compiler delegates to the evaluator's, whose onAwait already records the same set

the source store restated the pinned plugin's own early-out (source.includes("wgsl")) and attached the tag-identity assertion to the first transformed module behind a re-entrancy flag; it transforms every module and asserts once in its constructor
built module text was memoized per store instance, so every new UpstreamSourceStore re-minified the modules it read; the memo is one static map keyed by package root and module

findSourceExport parsed 280 modules per store to place one chunk re-export, and the diff added the minifier to each parse; a text prefilter on the exported name skips the parse for any module that never spells it

expectShapeCount fingerprinted every subtree under a body per call (the CSM fit went from 3 to 8 calls); expressionMatchesShape compares the node's fingerprint head with the expected one before walking

the Standard variant table gated uses_local_position on a hand-spelled `out.vLocalPos = position;` that had gone silently false under minified text (scene 145, MAD 2.6), while the PBR table derived the same fact another way; both call one checked reader that refuses when the varying is declared but never stored
the emitted update_csm_cascades kept view_frustum_z and frustum_lengths scratch arrays beside the cascade record fields holding the same doubles; the split loop reads the record
PhysicsLowerer.enumMembers re-implemented LoweringContext.objectInitializer; it calls it

write-corpus-manifest accepted any module-digest move once the scene's source had moved, an exemption rather than an explanation; it composes the previous source from --previous-tree under the reverted pin and requires the recorded digest, and its header no longer claims one column moves for one reason
pinnedShaderDefineLines and its defineLines callers said lines where the pin now appends texts with no separator; renamed pinnedShaderDefineText / defineText

the NO_COLOR_OUTPUT negative assertion was re-spelled to `->@location(0)`, text no variant contains since the return clause is an interpolated spaced string; restored to the spelling a colour arm carries

the playbook told the reader to follow a green compatibility report with a registry compile in prose; npm run upstream:report is that command, and the build-step explanation repeated in five places now points at the module header

the renderer lowerer's invariant marker loop re-asserted five markers the unconditional formula table already asserts (skybox ray and alphaG, volume attenuation, IOR Fresnel, scene-color copy); the duplicates are gone and the loop states why the conditional extension markers stay

every marker over packaged shader text is a hand transcription of the pin's minifier output, so the next separator-rule change breaks them all at once; keeping the source spelling and running the pinned transform over each marker at generation would follow the minifier automatically
findings.blockedBy: the markers span two minifiers (wgsl-tagged inline templates and ?raw miniray files) and no per-marker record says which produced its text; that classification does not exist yet
